fixed_statement:
Let \(p\notin \{0\}\cup\{1/k\mid k\in\mathbb{Z}^+\}\).
Let \(v_1,\ldots,v_m\) be i.i.d.\ Bernoulli\((p)\) random variables.

The inequality
\[
\Pr\Big[\sum_{i=1}^m w_i v_i\geq p\Big]\geq p
\]
does not universally hold; equivalently, there is a valid weight distribution \(w_1,\ldots,w_m\) for which
\[
\Pr\Big[\sum_{i=1}^m w_i v_i\geq p\Big]\lt p.
\]
